Part A: Solve \(n \equiv 0 \pmod 7\), \(n \equiv 4 \pmod 5\), \(n \equiv 3 \pmod 9\).  
Let \(n=7k\). Then \(k \equiv 2 \pmod 5\), so \(k=5a+2\), giving \(n=35a+14\).  
Then \(35a+14 \equiv 3 \pmod 9\), so \(a \equiv 2 \pmod 9\). Smallest \(a=2\), so \(n=84\).

Part B: Net period factor \(=1.015(0.9925)=1.0073875\). Applying the contributions in order gives balance \(13166.317279...\), so \(13166.32\).

Part C: Monthly rate \(=0.0065\). Payment \(=974.818525...\). Balance after 18 regular payments is \(16508.617265...\). Extra principal reductions: \(600(1.0065)^{12}+1000(1.0065)=1655.009886...\). Remaining balance \(=14853.607379...\), so \(14853.61\).

Part D: Sum multiples of 13 from 286 to 13897: \(7431892\). Sum multiples of 117 from 351 to 13806: \(821106\). Difference: \(7431892-821106=6610786\).

FINAL: 84; 13166.32; 14853.61; 6610786
